metaDescription: Distillation is a Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod that makes brewing a system you learn by playing: the stand teaches its own recipes, every vanilla effect becomes brewable, known recipes batch to six bottles, and antidotes cure one affliction at a time.
ogDescription: An alchemy overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric. Recipe discovery at the stand, the missing brews, batch brewing, honest durations, premium potions, and antidotes.

hero.sub: Distillation makes brewing a craft you learn instead of a chart you look up — a stand that teaches, potions worth planning around, cures that are decisions. Every recipe brews from items vanilla already ships.

sections.title: In Development
sections.lede: Distillation is fully designed and specced — implementation is underway. Nothing is released yet; everything below describes the design.

items.title: Brew by Discovery
html: Hold an ingredient over the stand and the vapor clouds with a color hint. A failed brew bottles a Murky Draught that names one ingredient that would have worked — and every success is written into your recipes page, permanently.

items.title: The Missing Brews
html: Resistance, Haste, Absorption, Luck, and Glowing — every effect vanilla shipped without a recipe becomes brewable, from a shulker shell, honey over a sugar brew, a golden apple, a nautilus shell, a glow ink sac.

items.title: Batch Brewing
html: Set the stand on a cauldron heated from below and a recipe you've discovered fills six bottles in one pass at 1.5× the ingredient cost. One session kits the whole raid party.

items.title: Antidotes
html: Surgical cures brewed from the affliction's own source — a poison antidote from a fermented spider eye, a wither antidote from a wither rose. Each strips exactly one effect; your 8-minute buffs stay.

blocks.html: Also in the design: utility potions at honest 8:00 durations you can sip in halves, an extended-and-amplified premium path at double the reagent, and 60-second lingering clouds that make a support brewer viable. Read the full promise in design/VISION.md.

sections.title: Part of Concord
sections.lede: Distillation is a member of Concord — a modular collection of system overhauls. Install any, combine all: every mod stands entirely on its own, and siblings light up together without ever being required.
